Chempunk Chainsword

3000 goldFinished item

A fighter item with attack damage, health and ability haste whose physical damage puts 40% Wounds on enemy champions (Wounds reduce their healing).

Stats

  • 45 Attack Damage
  • 450 Health
  • 15 Ability Haste

What it does

Hackshorn: Dealing physical damage applies 40% Wounds to enemy champions for 3 seconds.

When to buy it

Buy it on attack-damage fighters and junglers when the enemy team heals a lot.

Skip it whenIf the enemy barely heals, another damage item is better.

Good on

Darius Renekton Pantheon Riven Rengar

Builds from

Executioner's Calling Giant's Belt Caulfield's Warhammer

In our champion builds

None of our current builds use it.

When our guides switch to it

Healing or shields: Ezreal, Irelia, Smolder, Zed Jungle, Irelia Top, Zed
